admin.panel.title: Admin panel. Choose an action.
admin.grant.prompt:
Send the user id and number of days, separated by a space.
Example: 123456789 30
admin.grant.invalid: Invalid input. Send: user_id days (both positive integers).
admin.refset.prompt:
Send the user id and percent (0 to 99), separated by a space.
Example: 123456789 10
admin.refset.invalid: Invalid input. Send: user_id percent (0 to 99).
admin.refreset.prompt:
Send the user id to zero their referral balance.
Example: 123456789
admin.refreset.invalid: Invalid input. Send only the user id (a positive integer).
admin.refreset.success: Referral balance for user {user_id} was zeroed. Earnings settled: {cleared}.
